Shiny Server Module for Non-Blocking Cluster Monitoring and Recovery

Source: R/shiny_monitor.R
mod_hpc_monitor_server.Rd

Polls slurm_status() asynchronously using a self-throttling shiny::reactiveTimer() (idling automatically once a job reaches a terminal state and resuming immediately on new submissions or surgical retries). Handles chunk-level surgical retries, job cancellation, polling pause/resume, automatic or manual result collection, and log inspection.

Usage

mod_hpc_monitor_server(
  id,
  job,
  poll_ms = 400L,
  auto_collect = TRUE,
  simplify = FALSE,
  max_retries = 5L,
  retry_mem_multiplier = 1.5
)

Arguments

id

Character module namespace ID matching mod_hpc_monitor_ui().

job

A reactive returning a slurmpilot_job handle (or NULL).

poll_ms

Polling interval in milliseconds. Default 400L.

auto_collect

Logical; if TRUE (default), automatically collects ordered results once the job reaches "COMPLETED".

simplify

Logical passed to slurm_collect(). Default FALSE.

max_retries

Positive integer cap on surgical retry button clicks per job (clamped to [1, 50]). Default 5L.

retry_mem_multiplier

Memory scaling multiplier applied when bump_mem is checked (clamped to [1.0, 4.0]). Default 1.5.

Value

A named list of reactives:

  • status: latest slurmpilot_status object (or NULL).

  • results: collected results (or NULL until collected).

  • is_polling: logical reactive indicating whether live polling is active.

  • job: active slurmpilot_job handle (updated on surgical retries).

See also

mod_hpc_monitor_ui(), mod_hpc_submit_server()

Examples

# \donttest{
if (interactive() && requireNamespace("shiny", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("bslib", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ui <- bslib::page_fluid(
    mod_hpc_submit_ui("sub"),
    mod_hpc_monitor_ui("mon")
  )
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    be <- mock_slurm_backend(max_workers = 2L)
    sub <- mod_hpc_submit_server(
      "sub",
      backend = be,
      fun = function(x) x^2,
      args_builder = function(n) as.list(seq_len(n))
    )
    mod_hpc_monitor_server("mon", job = sub$job)
  }
  shiny::shinyApp(ui, server)
}
# }
